C.domain: Subtracting fractions and mixed numbers (including regrouping and simplification)

skills.name: Common denominator conversion
skills.definition: Find a least common denominator (LCD) and rewrite one or both fractions as equivalent fractions with that denominator.
inclusion_criteria: Solution explicitly finds an LCD/LCM of denominators
Solution scales numerators/denominators to create like denominators before subtracting
exclusion_criteria: Fractions already have the same denominator and no conversion is performed
Only simplifying/reducing a fraction (e.g., 4/10 to 2/5) without creating a common denominator for subtraction

skills.name: Subtract like-denominator fractions
skills.definition: Subtract fractions once they share a denominator by subtracting numerators and keeping the denominator (including cases that yield 0 or a negative fraction).
inclusion_criteria: Solution performs (a/b) − (c/b) = (a−c)/b
Solution subtracts fractional parts of mixed numbers when denominators are already the same
exclusion_criteria: Steps that are only about finding an LCD or converting denominators
Borrowing/regrouping steps that change the whole number and fraction before re-subtracting

skills.name: Mixed/improper rewriting
skills.definition: Rewrite numbers into a convenient equivalent form for subtraction (e.g., mixed ↔ improper, or whole number as a fraction with a chosen denominator).
inclusion_criteria: Converts a mixed number to an improper fraction (or interprets a nonstandard mixed number like 1 4/3 as 1 + 4/3)
Rewrites a whole number as a mixed number or as a fraction with a specified denominator (e.g., 4 = 12/3, 2 = 1 3/3)
exclusion_criteria: Borrowing/regrouping after a negative fractional part is obtained (that is S04)
Only simplifying/reducing a fraction without changing the overall number form for subtraction

skills.name: Regroup and simplify result
skills.definition: When fractional subtraction is negative, borrow/regroup from the whole part to make the fraction nonnegative, then express the final answer in simplest form (reduced and/or as an integer/mixed number).
inclusion_criteria: Solution borrows 1 from the whole number and adds 1 (as b/b) to the fractional part to continue subtraction
Solution reduces a resulting fraction to lowest terms and/or converts 0/b to 0 as part of finalizing the answer
exclusion_criteria: Straight subtraction with no need to borrow/regroup and no simplification step shown
Only finding an LCD or only converting number forms without any regrouping or simplification

A.domain: Subtracting fractions and mixed numbers (including regrouping and simplification)

skills.name: Common denominator conversion
skills.definition: Find a least common denominator and rewrite one or both fractions as equivalent fractions with that denominator.
inclusion_criteria: Solution explicitly finds an LCD/LCM of denominators
Solution converts fractions to equivalent forms with a common denominator before subtracting
exclusion_criteria: Fractions already have the same denominator and no conversion is performed
Work only rewrites a whole number as a fraction (tag S03 instead)

skills.name: Subtract fraction parts
skills.definition: Compute the difference of two fractions once they share a denominator (including like-denominator subtraction and resulting negative fraction parts).
inclusion_criteria: Subtracts numerators over a common denominator (a/b − c/b)
Performs the fraction-part subtraction within mixed-number subtraction (e.g., 3/5 − 2/5 or 9/24 − 20/24)
exclusion_criteria: Only converts to common denominators without performing the subtraction
Only simplifies/reduces a fraction without subtracting (tag S04 instead)

skills.name: Mixed/whole rewriting
skills.definition: Rewrite mixed numbers or whole numbers into an equivalent form (improper fraction or mixed form with a chosen denominator) to enable subtraction.
inclusion_criteria: Converts a mixed number to an improper fraction (e.g., 4 1/3 → 13/3)
Interprets a nonstandard mixed number with an improper fractional part (e.g., 1 4/3 → 1 + 4/3)
Rewrites a whole number as a mixed number or as a fraction with a specified denominator (e.g., 2 → 1 3/3; 4 → 12/3)
exclusion_criteria: Only finds LCD and converts proper fractions (tag S01 instead)
Only borrows/regroups after a negative fraction part appears (tag S04 instead)

skills.name: Regroup and simplify
skills.definition: Regroup (borrow 1 whole as a full fraction) when needed and simplify the final numeric form (reduce fractions and/or combine whole and fractional parts).
inclusion_criteria: Borrows/regroups from the whole part to fix a negative fraction part (e.g., add 5/5, 10/10, 12/12, 24/24)
Reduces a fraction to lowest terms (e.g., 9/12 → 3/4; 4/10 → 2/5; 0/3 → 0)
Combines whole and fractional results into a final mixed number or integer
exclusion_criteria: Performs fraction subtraction without any regrouping or simplification beyond the subtraction itself (tag S02 instead)
Only finds common denominators and converts (tag S01 instead)

B.domain: Subtracting fractions and mixed numbers and simplifying results

skills.name: Common denominator conversion
skills.definition: Find a least common denominator (LCD) and rewrite one or both fractions as equivalent fractions with that denominator.
inclusion_criteria: Solution explicitly finds an LCD/LCM of denominators
Solution rewrites fractions to equivalent forms with a shared denominator before subtracting
exclusion_criteria: Fractions already have the same denominator and no conversion is performed
Only simplifying/reducing a fraction (e.g., 4/10 to 2/5) without matching denominators for subtraction

skills.name: Subtract fractional parts
skills.definition: Subtract fractions once they share a denominator (including like-denominator subtraction and numerator subtraction).
inclusion_criteria: Solution subtracts numerators over a common denominator (e.g., a/b − c/b = (a−c)/b)
Solution performs the fraction-part subtraction within mixed-number subtraction
exclusion_criteria: Only finds LCD/converts but does not execute the subtraction
Only borrows/regroups without actually carrying out the fraction subtraction

skills.name: Mixed/whole rewriting
skills.definition: Rewrite mixed numbers or whole numbers into an equivalent form (separating whole and fraction parts or converting to improper fractions / matching-denominator whole-number fractions) to enable subtraction.
inclusion_criteria: Solution separates a mixed number into whole and fractional parts for subtraction
Solution converts a mixed number to an improper fraction (or interprets a nonstandard mixed number like 1 4/3 as 1 + 4/3)
Solution rewrites a whole number as a fraction with a specified denominator (e.g., 4 = 12/3; 2 = 1 3/3)
exclusion_criteria: Only performs borrowing/regrouping after a negative fractional difference is found (tag S04 instead)
Only reduces/simplifies a fraction without changing representation between mixed/whole/improper forms

skills.name: Borrow/regroup in subtraction
skills.definition: Regroup by borrowing 1 from the whole part (or adding 1 whole as denominator/denominator) when the fractional subtraction would be negative, then recompute the fractional difference.
inclusion_criteria: Solution identifies a negative fractional part (e.g., 0/5 − 1/5 or 4/12 − 7/12) and then borrows 1 from the whole number
Solution adds an equivalent 1 (e.g., 5/5, 12/12, 24/24, 10/10) to the fractional part after borrowing
exclusion_criteria: No regrouping is needed because the fractional part is nonnegative
Only converts to improper fractions and subtracts directly without any borrowing step
